title: Compiler Modes and Fallbacks
summary: Exercise compiled and shadow execution paths while surfacing when work falls back to the legacy path during rapid compiler iteration.
whySQLiteFallsShort: SQLite does not expose a native query-compiler rollout story with shadow mode and explicit fallback metrics as part of the product contract.
SydraDB's compiler work can be demonstrated honestly while it evolves because execution mode and fallback reasons are visible in query responses and metrics.
This lets the team ship compiler improvements incrementally instead of treating the engine as a black box until release day.

steps.title: Run a compiled-supported query
steps.summary: Confirm the compiled mode stays on the native path for a supported aggregate query.
steps.query: select tag.host as host, avg(value) as avg_value from edge.power_kw where tag.site = 'edge-east' group by tag.host

steps.title: Trigger a compiled fallback
steps.summary: Run a linear fill clause that still falls back cleanly today so compiled mode reports legacy takeover instead of failing opaquely.
steps.query: select time_bucket(60, time) as bucket, avg(value) as avg_value from edge.power_kw where time >= 0 group by time_bucket(60, time) fill(linear) order by bucket desc

steps.title: Compare shadow-mode fallback behavior
steps.summary: Run the same linear fill query under shadow mode so the UI can highlight mode-specific fallback behavior during compiler rollout.
steps.query: select time_bucket(60, time) as bucket, avg(value) as avg_value from edge.power_kw where time >= 0 group by time_bucket(60, time) fill(linear) order by bucket desc

steps.title: Read compiler fallback counters
steps.summary: Fetch the Prometheus counters that track compiler attempts and fallback volume for the running compiled server.
